description: This file defines the PdfFormXObject class, which represents an external form object (e.g., an imported page) in a PDF document. It includes constructors for different initialization scenarios, resource management, and methods to handle font and image resource naming, as well as internal mechanisms for importing PDF resources within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: PdfFormXObject
classes.description: Represents an external form object such as an imported page in a PDF document.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a font resource and returns its name within the form's resources.

methods.name: GetFontName (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a font resource based on font ID and data, returning its name.

methods.description: Method stub to get image resource name; not implemented.

methods.description: Method stub to get form resource name; not implemented.
